notes: Round 2 of the UX audit. (1) Added text group labels (FLEET ANALYSIS / CUSTOMER DELIVERABLES / AS-BUILT DOCUMENT) to the Action Planner's 19-tab row, so the 13 customer-ready deliverables (previously buried as sub-tab 9 of an unbroken flat list) are visually distinct from the fleet-analysis tabs around them -- purely additive markup, no tab renumbering. (2) New 'Needs Attention' card on the Overview dashboard: ranks and surfaces the top 5 highest-risk systems (by critical/high risk count, then soonest-expiring contract) in current scope, each one click away from Technical Audit via focusOnSystem(). Previously Overview had 4 equally-weighted KPI counters and no ranked starting point for a returning TAM. Verified live: clicking a Needs Attention row correctly focuses that system and switches to Technical Audit.
